_comment: SDC26 v7 OFFICIAL competition arena (ILA Berlin, 11 Jun 2026). Drop into ~/.marker_mission/active_arena_config.json on each FC. Coordinate convention matches strategy/roles.in_home_zone + strategy/attacker.py: long axis = Y (20 m, red home y in [-10,-5], blue home y in [5,10]); width = X (10 m, x in [-5,+5]); origin at field centre. Marker placement per regs §4.4 Fig 3: 8 pillars x 2 markers (upper z=4 m IDs 1-8, lower z=2 m IDs 9-16), DICT_4X4_50, 0.5 m square markers.
_magnetic_north_note: PLACEHOLDER 0.0 — MUST be measured on-site at ILA Berlin and patched in before flight (POST /api/arena/active on each FC, or edit the file and restart marker-mission). The single-marker positioning branch picker (magnetometer-validated IPPE) needs this; with a wrong value it can land on the wrong (mirrored) branch and the wall guard / world-seek will drive the drone the wrong way.
